context_manifest.patch_state: uncommitted working tree changes prepared for independent EvidenceGate review

migrations: Added a new plan_execution module for PlanExecution, NodeRun, checkpoint, static scheduling, projection, and reconciliation records.
Added PlanExecution, NodeRun and checkpoint budget snapshots plus wall-clock budget enforcement.
Exported the new static PlanIR execution API from ahra.__init__.
Added plan_execution.py to the adapter-dependency lint boundary.
Added focused tests for TASK-0029 scheduler and state semantics.

acceptance_map.criterion: Only admitted immutable PlanIR can start execution.
DAG dependencies, concurrency limits, budgets and deadlines are enforced.
Crash/restart simulation resumes from checkpoint without repeating completed idempotent nodes.
Stale lease/fencing token writes are rejected.
Cancellation propagates to active nodes and leaves auditable terminal state.
Task/Goal, PlanExecution and NodeRun each retain distinct authority.
The static vertical slice produces complete Artifact/Evidence/Trace/Handoff records and passes the Goal completion gate.

known_limitations: The store is an in-memory reference implementation for contract and scheduler semantics, not a distributed durable store.
The scheduler executes admitted static PlanIR only; TASK-0030 remains responsible for dynamic Planner adapter and bounded replan protocol.
Verification node execution invokes the existing VerificationService interface; it does not introduce a new remote verifier worker.
The producer does not mark TASK-0029 completed; independent verifier and EvidenceGate decide completion.
